tr_ana.title: Otopark
tr_ana.content: Binanın önündeki sokakta park ücretsiz. Kapalı otopark yok.

tr_ana.title: Parti ve gürültü
tr_ana.content: Parti yapılmaz. Sessiz saatler 23:00 ile 08:00 arası.

tr_ana.title: Çöp
tr_ana.content: Çöpler binanın arka kapısının yanındaki konteynere atılır. Geri dönüşüm kutusu yok.

tr_ana.title: Havlu ve çarşaf
tr_ana.content: Banyo havlusu ve çarşaf veriyoruz. Plaj havlusu verilmez.

tr_ana.title: Giriş
tr_ana.content: Giriş 15:00'ten sonra. Anahtar kutusu kapının sağında, kodu 2580.

tr_ana.title: Havaalanı transferi
tr_ana.content: Havaalanından daireye transfer 900 TL, bir gün önceden haber verin.

tr_ana.title: Çamaşır makinesi
tr_ana.content: Çamaşır makinesi mutfakta, deterjan lavabonun altında. Kurutma makinesi yok.

tr_ana.title: Market
tr_ana.content: En yakın market 200 metre ileride, 07:00-23:00 açık.

tr_ana.title: Bebek yatağı
tr_ana.content: İstek üzerine ücretsiz bebek yatağı veriyoruz.

tr_ana.title: Klima
tr_ana.content: Her odada klima var, kumandalar komodinin çekmecesinde.

en_main.title: Parking
en_main.content: Garage parking is free for guests, your spot is number 14. There is no EV charging point.

en_main.title: Smoking & parties
en_main.content: No smoking anywhere inside the apartment. No parties or events.

en_main.title: Check-out
en_main.content: Leave the keys on the kitchen table and pull the door shut behind you.

en_main.title: Self check-in
en_main.content: Door code: 6194#. The same code opens the building entrance.

en_main.title: Kitchen
en_main.content: Fully equipped kitchen with oven, kettle and a capsule coffee machine. No dishwasher.

en_main.title: Balcony
en_main.content: The balcony has a small table and two chairs.

en_main.title: Linen & cleaning
en_main.content: Fresh sheets and towels are provided. Mid-stay cleaning is available for 600 TL.

en_main.title: Getting here
en_main.content: A taxi from the airport takes about 40 minutes and costs around 1,100 TL.

en_main.title: Beach
en_main.content: The nearest beach is a 10-minute walk. Beach umbrellas are not provided.

en_main.title: Rubbish
en_main.content: Bins are collected every evening. Put your bags in the green bin by the gate.

en_main.title: Luggage
en_main.content: After check-out you can leave your luggage in the hallway closet until 18:00.

en_main.title: Air conditioning
en_main.content: Air conditioning is in the bedroom only. The living room has a ceiling fan.

celiski.title: Ara temizlik
celiski.content: Ara temizlik salı ve cuma günleri yapılır.
